title: Mi Jong Lo Han Kung Fu and Tai Chi

services.name: Self Defense
services.desc: A fundamental course in self defense with a simple multi-layered approach starting with situational awareness and minimizing your potential as a target. Classes will progress to hand-to-hand applications and use of improvised “tools” for defensive purposes; basic evasion and escape techniques as well as strikes, kicks and take downs will be integral. blurb: This site is dedicated to the Traditional Chinese Martial Art of Mi Jong Lo Han and the legacy of the art as passed from the lineage of Great Grandmaster (GGM) Yeh Yu Ting through Grandmaster Raymond Wong (Wong Kwok Jung) to Sifu Brian Tuan at the MJLH Kung Fu studio in Lake Forest, CA.
